0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic, 4th in the East) are on the road for their fifth game of the season, coming off a loss after going 3-1 over their last ten games, while the Pacers (2-2, 3rd in the Central, 1 game back, 8th in the East) also dropped their most recent game. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet this season, but the 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, including a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
